title: Minimum model capacity (layers, heads, FFN width, scratchpad)
question: What is the smallest transformer (in n_layers, n_heads, d_ff, and d_scratch) that can solve base-conditioned column addition with multi-step carry chains, and does simultaneous operand alignment, in-context alphabet lookup, and carry threshold resolution require a hard minimum of n_layers >= 3? (Note: ParallelClassificationHead in cls adds d_model * (1 + 3 * 256) untied head parameters—+393,728 at d_model = 512 and >= 196,864 at d_model >= 256, including 254 untargeted classes on the 256-way flag head—versus 0 head parameters in SubspaceLMHead.)
